draft.emotion: straightforward and helpful, like pointing out a good deal
notes: Can modify a noun (免费饮料 'free drinks'), be used with 是…的 (是免费的 'is free'), or come directly before a verb as an adverb ('free of charge', e.g., 免费参观 'visit for free').
Only means 'costing no money'. For 'free time', use 有空 (yǒukòng); for 'freedom / unrestricted', use 自由 (zìyóu).
